title: Disposition Enlarge Naming
description: Dispositions can be enlarged. Remove legacy fullscreen naming — it is called enlarge (CSS classes, API, tests, docstrings).
summary: Renamed legacy disposition fullscreen naming to enlarge across the presentation React renderer: API (`isEnlarged`, `toggleEnlarge`, `toggleEnlargeRect`, `SLIDE_INTERACTIVE_ENLARGE_FRAME`, `PresentationDispositionEnlargeContext`), CSS classes (`--enlarged`, `presentation-interaction-enlarge`), UI titles (Enlarge / Exit enlarge), and regression tests. 84/85 renderer tests pass; one pre-existing PDF cover-scale test remains failing.
